description: This file defines the Comment controller class within an OpenCart ecommerce platform, managing actions related to article comments such as listing, adding, replying, rating, and displaying comments. It interacts with models, views, sessions, and external controllers for comprehensive comment management within a CMS module.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class managing CMS article comments within OpenCart, providing methods for displaying comment lists, adding comments, replying, and rating comments.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the comment section for an article, preparing data including sorting, pagination, captcha, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of comments by invoking the getList controller, typically used for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a paginated list of comments for a given article, including comment details, pagination controls, and user actions.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Invokes the getReplies controller to fetch and display replies to a specific comment.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches replies to a comment with pagination support and renders the replies section.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles addition of a new comment or reply, including validation, captcha, spam check, and comment approval logic.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Processes rating (like/dislike) actions on comments, updating the ratings count and ensuring token validation.
